observations_from_source.initial_hidden_gradient_exactly_zero: Last affine weights and biases are zero; derivative with respect to either hidden layer is multiplied by the zero last-layer weight. This also holds for spatial-gradient losses.
observations_from_source.initial_output_gradient: Potentially nonzero through frozen random hidden features/envelope; nonzero is not guaranteed for every coordinate.
observations_from_source.later_hidden_gradient: May become small with small output weights; actual norms/conditioning are not established by source alone.
observations_from_source.optimizer: Child-only limited-memory BFGS, identity/scalar initial metric, Armijo line search and curvature threshold; not affine-invariant in this implementation.

same_family_option.parameterization: theta = D z, fixed invertible diagonal D; initialize z=D^-1 theta0 and reconstruct theta before every model/objective evaluation
same_family_option.gradient: g_z = D^T g_theta; initial steepest-descent theta step is proportional to -D D^T g_theta
same_family_option.family_and_objective: Exactly same represented functions and scalar objective when reconstruction is used consistently; only optimizer coordinates/trajectory change.
same_family_option.zero_start_limit: No finite nonzero diagonal scaling makes initially zero hidden gradients nonzero. Scaling may alter subsequent relative updates once output weights become nonzero.
same_family_option.output_multiplier_limit: A fixed nonzero multiplier on each head can be absorbed into its output weights; it primarily rescales output coordinates and does not by itself establish better hidden-layer conditioning.
same_family_option.risks: Large hidden scaling can create large physical parameter moves/saturation; line search/curvature screening and finite arithmetic are coordinate-dependent. No scale chosen before evidence.

anchored_option.parameterization: parent(x) + f(theta,x) - f(theta0,x), with frozen nonzero-output theta0
anchored_option.initial_function: Exactly parent at theta=theta0 while hidden-coordinate derivatives can be nonzero.
anchored_option.family_distinction: For a fixed-width nonlinear head family, subtracting a fixed nonzero network translates the correction family; equality to the original unanchored family is not established. It also adds frozen-network evaluation/cache and serialization obligations.

Report retained curvature-pair block norms/cross terms where available; do not infer missing intermediate directions or full Hessian condition numbers.
